mapper.select: SELECT * FROM direct_sale ORDER BY seq DESC
SELECT * FROM direct_sale WHERE seq = #{seq} and status != '삭제'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO direct_sale (seq, name, description, product_name, image_url, price, created_at, seller_seq, category_seq, trade_location_seq) VALUES (direct_sale_seq.nextval, #{name}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{productName}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, SYSDATE, #{sellerSeq}, #{categorySeq}, #{tradeLocationSeq, jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.update: UPDATE direct_sale SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, product_name = #{productName}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, price = #{price}, category_seq = #{categorySeq}, trade_location_seq = #{tradeLocationSeq} WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.select: SELECT ds.seq, ds.name, ds.product_name AS productName, ds.price, ds.image_url AS imageUrl, ds.status, tl.dong, tl.lat, tl.lng, m.name AS sellerName, ds.created_at AS createdAt FROM direct_sale ds JOIN member m ON ds.seller_seq = m.seq LEFT JOIN trade_location tl ON ds.trade_location_seq = tl.seq WHERE ds.status != '삭제' ORDER BY ds.seq DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT ds.seq AS seq, ds.name AS name, ds.description AS description, ds.status AS status, ds.product_name AS productName, ds.image_url AS imageUrl, ds.price AS price, ds.created_at AS createdAt, ds.category_seq AS categorySeq, ds.trade_location_seq AS tradeLocationSeq,
m.seq AS sellerSeq, m.nickname AS sellerNickname, m.address AS sellerAddress,
tl.seq AS location_seq, tl.dong AS location_dong, tl.lat AS location_lat, tl.lng AS location_lng,
(SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(tr.score), 1), 0) FROM trade_review tr WHERE tr.seller_seq = m.seq) AS sellerRating,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_review tr WHERE tr.seller_seq = m.seq) AS tradeCount
FROM direct_sale ds JOIN member m ON ds.seller_seq = m.seq
LEFT JOIN trade_location tl ON ds.trade_location_seq = tl.seq
WHERE ds.seq = #{seq} AND ds.status != '삭제'
mapper.update: UPDATE direct_sale SET status = '삭제' WHERE seq = #{seq}
